title: fumaria densiflora subsp. bracteosa
intro: Fumaria densiflora subsp. bracteosa, commonly known as Fumitory or Fumaria, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family, Papaveraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as a natural diuretic, to treat digestive issues, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an anti-bacterial and anti-fungal agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fumaria densiflora subsp. bracteosa include alkaloids, such as berberine, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
